gloss: in small increments; bit by bit

definitions.gloss: in small increments; bit by bit; in small steps
definitions.explanation: Describes something done in frequent small amounts or movements rather than in large ones. Often used with に as an adverb. Composed of 小 (small) + 刻み (chopping, increments).

examples.japanese: {小刻|こきざ}み⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{震|ふる}えている→震える：02411_furueru⟧。
⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{小刻|こきざ}み⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{上|あ}がっている→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: The price is going up in small increments.

examples.japanese: {小刻|こきざ}みな⟦{休憩|きゅうけい}→休憩：00262_kyuukei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{長距離|ちょうきょり}→長距離：09271_choukyori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{走|はし}った→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。
examples.english: I ran a long distance while taking frequent short breaks.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly used adverbially as {小刻|こきざ}み⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ to describe actions done in rapid, small repetitions — trembling, tapping, stepping, or gradual changes. Can also be used as a na-adjective with な: {小刻|こきざ}みな⟦{動|うご}き→動き：11926_ugoki⟧ (small, quick movements).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {小刻|こきざ}み⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{震|ふる}える→震える：02411_furueru⟧ (to tremble in small shakes)
- {小刻|こきざ}み⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{動|うご}く→動く：00904_ugoku⟧ (to move in quick, small motions)
- {小刻|こきざ}みな⟦{変動|へんどう}→変動：09936_hendou⟧ (small fluctuations)
- {小刻|こきざ}み⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{休憩|きゅうけい}→休憩：00262_kyuukei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to take frequent short breaks)
